properties.NAME: Former Keng Teck Whay Building
properties.DESCRIPTION: Once home to one of Singapore's oldest self-help organisations, the Former Keng Teck Whay Building is situated next to Thian Hock Keng.

properties.NAME: Former Singapore Conference Hall and Trade Union House (now Singapore Conference Hall)
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Former Singapore Conference Hall and Trade Union House was constructed to house the headquarters of the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC) as the fulfilment of an election promise.

properties.NAME: St. George's Church
properties.DESCRIPTION: Saint George's Church is situated in the quiet environs off Minden Road, a short distance from the bustling shopping district of Orchard Road.

properties.NAME: St Joseph's Church
properties.DESCRIPTION: Saint Joseph's Church on Victoria Street was the headquarters of the Portuguese Mission in Singapore.

properties.NAME: Yueh Hai Ching Temple
properties.DESCRIPTION: Dwarfed by modern skyscrapers in the heart of the Central Business District is one of Singapore's oldest Chinese temples, Yueh Hai Ching Temple.

properties.NAME: Al-Abrar Mosque
properties.DESCRIPTION: Located on Telok Ayer Street, a short walk from Thian Hock Keng, the Former Keng Teck Whay Building, and the Former Nagore Dargah, Al-Abrar Mosque is one of Singapore's oldest mosques.

properties.NAME: College of Medicine Building
properties.DESCRIPTION: The College of Medicine Building is located at the rear of the Singapore General Hospital's compound, next to Tan Teck Guan Building.

properties.NAME: Jamae Mosque
properties.DESCRIPTION: Like the nearby Sri Mariamman Temple, Jamae Mosque has been a familiar landmark on South Bridge Road since the mid-nineteenth century.

properties.NAME: MacDonald House
properties.DESCRIPTION: Located not far from the Istana and the Former Cathay Building, MacDonald House has a relatively plain and unadorned facade that does not appear to be exceptionally striking.

properties.NAME: Former Siong Lim Temple (now Lian Shan Shuang Lin Monastery)
properties.DESCRIPTION: The traditional architecture of Lian Shan Shuang Lin Monastery - or 'Twin Grove Monastery on Lotus Hill' - stands out amidst the modern high-rise apartment blocks in the Toa Payoh neighbourhood.

properties.NAME: Former Nagore Dargah
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Former Nagore Dargah is situated on the historic Telok Ayer Street, a short distance from Telok Ayer Chinese Methodist Church, Al-Abrar Mosque and Thian Hock Keng.

properties.NAME: Prinsep Street Presbyterian Church
properties.DESCRIPTION: Prinsep Street Presbyterian Church is one of Singapore's oldest Presbyterian churches.

properties.NAME: Telok Ayer Chinese Methodist Church
properties.DESCRIPTION: Originally known as the Chinese Methodist Church, Telok Ayer Chinese Methodist Church was the first church established to cater exclusively to the spiritual needs of the Chinese Methodist community.

properties.NAME: Fort Siloso
properties.DESCRIPTION: Fort Siloso was one of the many coastal fortifications built around the 19th century by the British and remains the most intact fortification in Singapore.

properties.NAME: The Padang
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Padang is one of the oldest open spaces in Singapore for public recreation and a commemorative space for people to gather, witness and participate in key milestones of Singapore�s history.

properties.NAME: Former Kandang Kerbau Hospital
properties.DESCRIPTION: Built between the 1930s-1950s, these blocks are representative buildings of the former KKH and showcase the hospital�s instrumental role in advancing midwifery, maternal, and gynaecological care in Singapore.

properties.NAME: 38 Oxley Road
properties.DESCRIPTION: The site at 38 Oxley Road bore witness to pivotal events in the 1950s that marked Singapore�s transition from a colony to an independent nation.

properties.NAME: Sultan Mosque
properties.DESCRIPTION: Formerly the royal mosque of the Sultan of Johor, Sultan Mosque represents the solidarity and unity of Muslims in Singapore.

properties.NAME: Former Empress Place Building (now Asian Civilisations Museum)
properties.DESCRIPTION: Situated at the mouth of the Singapore River, the Former Empress Place Building was an important government building in Singapore up to the 1980s.

properties.NAME: Goodwood Park Hotel (Tower Block)
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Tower Wing of the present-day Goodwood Park Hotel was home to the German Teutonia Club, one of the earliest European national clubs in Singapore.

properties.NAME: Tan Teck Guan Building
properties.DESCRIPTION: Standing beside the College of Medicine Building is a smaller, two-storey building known as Tan Teck Guan Building.

properties.NAME: Changi Prison Gate Wall and Turrets
properties.DESCRIPTION: Changi Prison was designed to be a maximum security prison to house up to 600 criminals sentenced to long-term imprisonment in British Singapore.

properties.NAME: Former Saint Joseph's Institution (now Singapore Art Museum)
properties.DESCRIPTION: Saint Joseph's Institution is the oldest Catholic boys' school in Singapore and was founded by the Christian Brothers (formally known as the Institute of the Brothers of the Christian Schools)

properties.NAME: Former Attorney-Generals Chambers (now Parliament House Block C)
properties.DESCRIPTION: Tucked away in a corner near the Padang is a beautiful structure that once housed the Attorney-General's Chambers.

properties.NAME: Former Nanyang University Library and Administration Building, Memorial and Arch
properties.DESCRIPTION: Nanyang University, affectionately known as Nantah, was the first Chinese-language university in Southeast Asia and the second university in Singapore.

properties.NAME: Church of the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Church of the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary is one of the earliest Catholic churches built in the suburbs of Singapore.

properties.NAME: Former Convent of the Holy Infant Jesus Chapel and Caldwell House (now CHIJMES)
properties.DESCRIPTION: Owing to its central location, the Convent of the Holy Infant Jesus was also affectionately referred to as the Town Convent in the past.

properties.NAME: Abdul Gafoor Mosque
properties.DESCRIPTION: Abdul Gafoor Mosque's charming architecture stands out amidst the surrounding shophouses in the historic Little India district.

properties.NAME: Church of Saints Peter and Paul
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Church of Saints Peter and Paul is one of the oldest Catholic churches in Singapore that catered to a predominantly Chinese congregation.

properties.NAME: Chinese High School Clock Tower
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Chinese High School Clock Tower Building is the icon of the oldest Chinese-medium high school in Singapore and has been a visual landmark of Bukit Timah Road since its completion.

properties.NAME: Istana Kampong Gelam
properties.DESCRIPTION: Within the historic district of Kampong Gelam lies Istana Kampong Gelam ('Gelam Village Palace').

properties.NAME: Chesed-El Synagogue
properties.DESCRIPTION: Chesed-El Synagogue on Oxley Rise is one of two synagogues in Singapore, the other being Maghain Aboth Synagogue on Waterloo Street.

properties.NAME: Former City Hall
properties.DESCRIPTION: Located in the heart of the Civic District, the Former City Hall served as an important government office in Singapore.

properties.NAME: Hajjah Fatimah Mosque
properties.DESCRIPTION: Hajjah Fatimah Mosque is one of the oldest mosques in Singapore, a rare example of one named after a woman.

properties.NAME: Former Supreme Court
properties.DESCRIPTION: Amidst the colonial buildings and skyscrapers of the Civic District rises the copper-green dome of the Former Supreme Court.

properties.NAME: Sri Perumal Temple
properties.DESCRIPTION: Formerly known as Sri Narasimha Perumal Temple, Sri Srinivasa Perumal Temple is the first Hindu temple in Singapore dedicated to Sri Perumal, the Hindu deity more commonly known as Vishnu.

properties.NAME: Cathedral of the Good Shepherd
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Cathedral of the Good Shepherd is Singapore's oldest Catholic place of worship and the seat of the local Roman Catholic archbishop.

properties.NAME: Alkaff Upper Serangoon Mosque
properties.DESCRIPTION: Alkaff Upper Serangoon Mosque was constructed by the mercantile and landowning Alkaff family to serve the spiritual needs of the local Muslim community at large.

properties.NAME: Jurong Town Hall
properties.DESCRIPTION: On a hill overlooking Jurong estate, Jurong Town Hall once served as the headquarters of Jurong Town Corporation (JTC, presently JTC Corporation).

properties.NAME: The Istana and Sri Temasek
properties.DESCRIPTION: Shielded from the bustling Orchard Road by a sprawling green lung, the Istana ('Palace' in Malay) is the official residence of the President of the Republic of Singapore.

properties.NAME: Former Telok Ayer Market (now known as Lau Pa Sat)
properties.DESCRIPTION: Affectionately known as Lau Pa Sat ('Old Market') by generations of Singaporeans, the Former Telok Ayer Market was one of Singapore's oldest markets.

properties.NAME: Former Ministry of Labour Building (now Family Justice Courts)
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Former Ministry of Labour Building is located not far away from the Former Thong Chai Medical Institution and Tan Si Chong Su.

properties.NAME: Sri Mariamman Temple
properties.DESCRIPTION: Together with Jamae Mosque, Sri Mariamman Temple - Singapore's oldest Hindu temple - is an enduring icon on South Bridge Road which is a part of Chinatown.

properties.NAME: Thian Hock Keng
properties.DESCRIPTION: Thian Hock Keng ('Palace of Heavenly Happiness') is one of Singapore's oldest Hokkien temples.

properties.NAME: Sri Thendayuthapani Temple
properties.DESCRIPTION: Sri Thendayuthapani Temple, commonly referred to as the Chettiars' Temple, is one of Singapore's oldest Hindu temples dedicated to Murugan, the Hindu deity who is also known as Sri Thendayuthapani.

properties.NAME: St. Andrew's Cathedral
properties.DESCRIPTION: Saint Andrew's Cathedral is Singapore's oldest surviving Anglican place of worship and is the seat of the Anglican bishop of Singapore.

properties.NAME: Tan Si Chong Su
properties.DESCRIPTION: The history of Tan Si Chong Su ('Ancestral Hall of the Tan Clan') is inextricably linked to the influx of Chinese immigrants into Singapore during the late nineteenth century.

properties.NAME: Former Fullerton Building
properties.DESCRIPTION: The former Fullerton Building is a prominent landmark situated at the mouth of the Singapore River.

properties.NAME: Victoria Theatre and Concert Hall
properties.DESCRIPTION: In the heart of Singapore's historic Civic District stand the magnificent Victoria Theatre and Victoria Concert Hall with the iconic clock tower.

properties.NAME: Ying Fo Fui Kun
properties.DESCRIPTION: Not far from Former Nagore Dargah on Telok Ayer Street is Ying Fo Fui Kun, Singapore's oldest Hakka clan association.

properties.NAME: Armenian Apostolic Church of Saint Gregory the Illuminator
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Armenian Apostolic Church of Saint Gregory the Illuminator - commonly called the Armenian Church - is Singapore's oldest Christian church

properties.NAME: Former Cathay Building (now The Cathay)
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Art Deco facade wall fronting the modern glass architecture of The Cathay is the remnant of what used to be Malaya's tallest building.

properties.NAME: Former Thong Chai Medical Institution
properties.DESCRIPTION: Home to the first free traditional Chinese medical clinic for the poor in Singapore, the Former Thong Chai Medical Institution testifies to the Chinese pioneers' spirit of mutual assistance and their generosity towards the poor and needy.

properties.NAME: Tou Mu Kung Temple
properties.DESCRIPTION: Tou Mu Kung Temple is the oldest temple in Singapore dedicated to the Taoist deity Jiu Huang Ye ('Nine Emperors' or 'Ninth Emperor').

properties.NAME: Church of St Teresa
properties.DESCRIPTION: Standing atop a little hill, the Church of Saint Teresa was originally constructed for the spiritual needs of the Hokkien-speaking Catholics living in the town area.

properties.NAME: Former St James Power Station
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Former Saint James Power Station was the first coal-fired power station on the island.

properties.NAME: Former Tanjong Pagar Railway Station
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Former Tanjong Pagar Railway Station was previously the southernmost terminal station of the Federated Malay States Railways.

properties.NAME: Civilian War Memorial
properties.DESCRIPTION: Not far from the Esplanade Park Memorials stands the Civilian War Memorial, the first memorial in Singapore dedicated to the civilian victims of the Japanese Occupation (1942-1945).

properties.NAME: Chung Cheng High School (Main) Administration Building and Entrance Arch
properties.DESCRIPTION: As one of Singapore's oldest Chinese high schools, Chung Cheng High School was among the firsts to make higher education accessible to Chinese youth.

properties.NAME: Former Hill Street Police Station
properties.DESCRIPTION: Nicknamed the 'Police Skyscraper' in the past, the Former Hill Street Police Station is prominently located at the junction of Hill Street and River Valley Road.

properties.NAME: National Museum of Singapore
properties.DESCRIPTION: With its wide facade and large dome, the National Museum of Singapore has been a prominent landmark on Stamford Road for over a century.

properties.NAME: Church of Our Lady of Lourdes
properties.DESCRIPTION: Known simply as the Indian Church or Tamil Church in the past, the Church of Our Lady of Lourdes is one of Singapore's oldest Catholic churches.

properties.NAME: Former House of Tan Yeok Nee
properties.DESCRIPTION: Standing out prominently from its modern surroundings, the Chinese-style Former House of Tan Yeok Nee is the sole survivor of the 'Four Grand Mansions' built in the late nineteenth-century.

properties.NAME: Hong San See
properties.DESCRIPTION: Hong San See ('Temple on Phoenix Hill'), perched on the side of Institution Hill off Mohamed Sultan Road, was established by Hokkien immigrants from Nan'an (or Lam Ann) County in Fujian Province.

properties.NAME: Former Tao Nan School (now The Peranakan Museum)
properties.DESCRIPTION: A stone's throw from the Armenian Church is a century-old building that used to house Tao Nan School, the first modern Chinese school in Singapore.

properties.NAME: Former Ford Factory (now Memories at Old Ford Factory)
properties.DESCRIPTION: Built atop a little hill, the Former Ford Factory has been a visual landmark in Bukit Timah since its completion in 1941.

properties.NAME: Former Raffles College (now NUS Campus at Bukit Timah)
properties.DESCRIPTION: Located next to the Singapore Botanic Gardens, the Former Raffles College is well hidden from the public eye.

properties.NAME: Bowyer Block
properties.DESCRIPTION: Amidst the modern blocks in the sprawling compound of Singapore General Hospital stands a Neoclassical building with its distinctive clock tower.

properties.NAME: Former Command House
properties.DESCRIPTION: The stately Former Command House is located near Bukit Timah Road, a major road constructed during the mid-nineteenth century and one of the last defences against the invading Japanese troops in 1942.

properties.NAME: Esplanade Park Memorials
properties.DESCRIPTION: Prior to the first land reclamation in 1843, the original shoreline of Singapore ran across the present Padang.

properties.NAME: Former Parliament House and Annex Building (now The Arts House)
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Former Parliament House is likely to be the oldest surviving building in Singapore.

properties.NAME: Raffles Hotel
properties.DESCRIPTION: Raffles Hotel is one of the most well-known luxury hotels in Singapore and the oldest surviving establishment of its kind on the island.

properties.NAME: Former Sun Yat Sen Villa (now Sun Yat Sen Nanyang Memorial Hall)
properties.DESCRIPTION: Sun Yat-sen Nanyang Memorial Hall is one of the few surviving examples of villas that were once common sights in British Singapore.

properties.NAME: Singapore River Bridges: Cavenagh Bridge, Anderson Bridge and Elgin Bridge
properties.DESCRIPTION: Cavenagh, Anderson and Elgin Bridges are the three most historic and architecturally impressive bridges that span the Singapore River. Collectively, they illustrate Singapore's growth as a trading port and flourishing city. Located at the historic mouth of the Singapore River, the bridges symbolically connected Singapore with the world as they facilitated the trade and transport links necessary for the growth of the city.

properties.NAME: Former Admiralty House
properties.DESCRIPTION: Surrounded by several ancillary buildings and facilities on a sprawling estate, the Former Admiralty House used to accommodate key military commanders based in Singapore.

properties.NAME: Maghain Aboth Synagogue
properties.DESCRIPTION: Located in the former Jewish neighbourhood, Maghain Aboth Synagogue is the oldest surviving synagogue not only in Singapore, but also in Southeast Asia.

properties.NAME: Central Fire Station
properties.DESCRIPTION: The Central Fire Station is the oldest surviving fire station in Singapore and is a living monument to the local firefighting force.
